title: Cycle contingency ledger, sprint-reserve allocation, and critical-path slimming
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Objective: Define a concrete, repeatable mechanism for reserving and spending cycle contingency capacity across PM/Eng/Design that minimizes rollovers and provides a transparent audit trail for scope cuts. Deliverables: 1) 'Cycle contingency ledger' specification with allocation algorithm and guardrails, 2) Sprint-reserve policy for point-level reserves and engineering shadow pool, 3) Critical-path slimming checklist and acceptance criteria for mid-cycle scope reductions.
background: We regularly see 10-25% throughput variance between planned and delivered work each cycle. Current ad-hoc buffers (undocumented slack, informal hold-back stories) lead to inconsistent tradeoffs, unclear ownership of cuts, and carryover. Leadership wants a predictable, auditable way to manage contingency so we reduce rollovers and improve stakeholder confidence in quarterly commitments.
acceptance_criteria: Contingency ledger doc accepted by Eng, Design, and GTM leads in the March roadmap review
Policy defines exact reserve percentages per team and method to surface reserves to weekly standups
Mechanism for approving contingency spends is defined (who, what signals, required artifacts) and integrated into the cycle board
A short-cycle experiment (2-week pilot) executed on Cycle 2026-W12 with at least two squads participating and post-mortem showing reduced unplanned carryover
Example ledger entries and a template added to Confluence with a permissions model for edits and view-only audit logs

allocation_algorithm_summary: Base reserve = floor( max( team_planned_points * 0.12, 4 ) ). Additive contingency band of up to 8% applied for high-risk initiatives (legacy infra, external dependency). Reserve ownership: 50% PM-held (prioritization reserve), 50% ENG-held (implementation buffer). Unspent reserve at cycle end converts to improvement backlog, not carryover. Spend approvals require a short justification linked to a ticket and a one-line risk signal in the cycle board.
critical_path_slimming_checklist: Identify top 3 end-to-end customer flows impacted by the initiative
Mark dependent infra/SDK/migrations and classify as blockable or deferrable
For each user-visible story, produce a 'thin' and 'small' variant with acceptance criteria
If >2 high-risk infra deps exist, escalate to ENG leads for a targeted mitigation plan
For any proposed cut, capture user impact and alternative mitigations in the ticket's description
communication_plan: Publish ledger policy to Confluence and link from cycle kickoff template
One-slide summary for roadmap review decks showing reserves per team and rationale
Weekly 'reserve burn' line in cycle health report with remaining points and spend approvals
Post-pilot blog + internal lightning talk documenting wins and failure modes
risks: Over-reserving reduces velocity and wastes capacity if teams are conservative
Under-governance could lead to stealth scope creep where reserve is used without product tradeoffs
Calculation edge cases for very small squads (2-3 engineers) where floor(4) may dominate
Tooling gap: Linear/board doesn't currently have a native ledger — manual template may cause friction
mitigations: Start with a conservative org-wide formula and iterate after pilot data
Require a 1:1 PM-ENG signature for spends > 50% of team reserve
Provide 'micro-squad' override where reserve is calculated differently for squads <5 engineers
Work with Platform to prototype a 'reserve' custom field in Linear or use a lightweight Google Sheet with changelog
